title: Is Your Model Fairly Certain? Uncertainty-Aware Fairness Evaluation for LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on pronoun-occupation co-reference resolution tasks (WinoBias and the custom SynthBias dataset) by calculating the UCerF metric, which jointly measures prediction correctness and model uncertainty (e.g., perplexity) when gendered pronouns are swapped.
Applying the uncertainty-aware fairness metric (UCerF) to the BBQ Lite dataset to evaluate bias across different demographics.
